senses.gloss: m. (an adapt. of ξέστης, by confusion with כּוֹס, כַּסָּא) kusta, a liquid measure.
units: Sabb. 109ᵇ חד כ׳ דשיכרא (Ms. O. כִּיסְתָּא) one k. of beer.—Pl. כּוּסְיָתָא (fem.).

<cite ref="Shabbat 109b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>חמש עשר כ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>חמשא כוסתא</he>, Ms. O. <he>כסתתא</he>; Rashi <cite ref="K00319"><he>כּוֹסָאתָא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note). [Oth. opin. <cite ref="K00332"><he>כּוֹסְתָא</he></cite> fem. form of <cite ref="K00317"><he>כּוֹסָא</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="K00891"><he>כַּסָּא</he></cite>.]
